edibles.heading: Edibles at Kennedy Loud in Brampton
paragraphs: Kennedy Loud Cannabis is the 24-hour walk-in dispensary at 49 Hillcrest Ave Unit 104 in Brampton, on the Hillcrest Ave and Kennedy Road corridor. Use this page to review edible listings before you visit.

Edibles are sealed cannabis foods and drinks. Shop them by pack name, flavour, format, and the milligram details printed on the label. That is a separate category from flower jars and from vapes. Start with the edible page, then compare those listings with what is on the shelf.
Posted prices can change. The live menu is the current list, not a promise that a pack will still be there when you arrive. Call +1 (289) 206-1181 if you are coming for one specific edible.
Walk in at Unit 104. No appointment is required. Bring valid government-issued photo ID. You must be 19 or older. Ask staff to show the edible section and the labelled packs available that visit.
If two people are splitting the trip across Brampton, send 49 Hillcrest Ave Unit 104, not a generic downtown pin.
Use Hillcrest Ave and Kennedy Road as the meeting point.

vape-disposables.heading: THC Vapes at Kennedy Loud in Brampton
paragraphs: Kennedy Loud Cannabis is at 49 Hillcrest Ave Unit 104, on the Hillcrest Ave and Kennedy Road side of Brampton. Open 24 Hours. THC vapes are the cannabis vapour-product category at this Hillcrest address.

THC vapes are sealed cannabis vapour items listed by brand, flavour notes, and posted potency. Formats on the shelf change. Check the live menu for what is actually listed rather than assuming a particular hardware style will be in the case.
Posted prices can change. If a single vape listing is the reason you are crossing Kennedy Road, call +1 (289) 206-1181 before you leave.
Walk in at Unit 104 whenever you are nearby. Bring photo ID. Adults 19+ only. Staff can pull the vape section and help you read the current labels.
If you only have a few minutes on Hillcrest, open the live vape page first and write down two or three listed names. At the counter, ask for those names.
Hillcrest Ave, Unit 104, is the store. Keep that pin until you arrive.

concentrates.heading: Concentrates at Kennedy Loud in Brampton
paragraphs: Kennedy Loud Cannabis is the 24-hour Hillcrest Ave and Kennedy Road location at 49 Hillcrest Ave Unit 104 in Brampton. Concentrates at Unit 104 are the extract products on this menu.

Concentrates are packaged cannabis extracts. Listings usually show name, extract style, listed potency, and pack weight. That is not the same as choosing flower by tier or choosing an edible pack. Read the concentrate page, then confirm the same names in the store.
The live menu is the only current list. Posted prices can change. Call +1 (289) 206-1181 if you need one extract confirmed before you travel across Brampton.
Walk in at Unit 104. No appointment. Bring ID. The counter serves adults 19 and older. Ask to see the concentrate section and compare labelled items on the spot.
Bring the live-menu name, not a nickname from another shop. Staff can help you match that list to the labelled packs on the counter.
Remember the landmark: Hillcrest Ave and Kennedy Road, Unit 104.

A nic vape is a sealed nicotine vapour product listed by brand, flavour notes, and pack details. Hardware on the shelf changes. Check the live menu for current formats rather than guessing what will be in the case. This category is separate from THC vapes.
Posted prices can change. If one nic vape name is why you are crossing Kennedy Road, call +1 (289) 206-1181.
Walk in at Unit 104. No appointment. Bring valid photo ID. Adults 19+ only. Ask staff for the nic vape section and compare labelled units with the names you wrote down.
Write down the listed nic vape names before you leave. At Unit 104, ask for those names. If the live menu does not show a format, do not plan the stop around it.
Keep nic vapes and flower on separate lists if you are buying both. Staff can move you between labelled sections once you are inside Unit 104.

flowerTiers.heading: Flower Tiers at Kennedy Loud in Brampton
paragraphs: Kennedy Loud Cannabis is at 49 Hillcrest Ave Unit 104, on the Hillcrest Ave and Kennedy Road side of Brampton. Open 24 Hours. Flower tiers are how this store groups dried cannabis on the live menu.

Dried flower is sold by listed name, weight, and posted price. Tier pages let you scan those listings in groups. That is not the same as shopping edibles or concentrates. Open the Hillcrest flower pages, then look for the same names at Unit 104.
Posted prices can change. Call +1 (289) 206-1181 if one listed name is the reason you are coming to Hillcrest Ave.
Walk in at Unit 104 whenever you are nearby. Bring government-issued photo ID. You must be 19 or older. Ask for the tier you reviewed and match labelled jars to that page.
Use Hillcrest Ave and Kennedy Road as the meeting point. Send Unit 104, not a generic Brampton pin.
A tier heading is only a group on the menu. It does not reserve a jar. Confirm the labelled name and weight at the counter.
Kennedy Road gets you close. Unit 104 finishes the trip.
